pr_body:
# Blazor form model expression formatting

With Blazor server-side rendering, we need to have the ability to map form request entries to their corresponding properties on the related model. This PR enables `Input*` components to render a `name` attribute that makes this mapping possible.

Fixes #47780
pr_comments: Azure Pipelines successfully started running 3 pipeline(s).

issue_context.title: Generate form field identifiers for Blazor server-side rendering
issue_context.body:
When using Blazor server-side rendering, we need to generate string values for each form input's `name` attribute so that we can map form request values back to the original model.

This is a required step to complete https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/46981.

review_comments: Let's put a pin on this one, we don't have to deal with it in this PR, but it might be challenging if providing your own name breaks binding.
Let's go with this for now, and we'll revisit in preview5
